slides.texte_overlay:
Job interview rules every
young man should know

1. Arrive 10 minutes early

Not 30. Not 1.
Wait nearby if needed.

2. Dress one step above

Look like you already
work there, on a good day.

3. Bring your own questions

"What does success look like
in this role?"

4. Firm handshake, eye contact

The first five seconds count.

5. Know the company

What they do, who they serve.
Ten minutes of research shows.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Know the company

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app to
brush up on their field.
